completeProfile.title: Almost there
completeProfile.subtitle: We just need to know your home.

register.title: Create account
register.hint: Every resident has their own account. The administrator reviews the home details.
register.accept: I accept the privacy policy and the terms of use.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.body: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
verify.adminNote: The administrator is notified of your sign-up. You can use the app as soon as you verify your email.

recover.title: Reset password
recover.body: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
recover.sent: If that email has an account, we've sent a recovery link.

newPassword.title: New password
newPassword.tooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
newPassword.done: Password updated. You can sign in now.

errors.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: You need to verify your email before signing in.
errors.disabled: Your account is disabled. Contact the administrator.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.monthHint: You can only book up to 7 days ahead. Tap a day to see availability.

reservar.chooseUse: It's the same room. Choose the use.
reservar.salaHint: By blocks or by the hour, up to the whole day.
reservar.pingHint: Max 2 h. A review notice is sent when you finish.
reservar.transferHint: The booking is held until the administrator confirms the payment (max. 3 days).
reservar.acceptRules: By confirming you accept the space's rules of use.
reservar.blockedTitle: Your home can't book right now
reservar.blockedDefault: It's blocked for unpaid community fees.
reservar.err_impago: Your home is blocked for unpaid fees. Contact the administrator.
reservar.err_generic: The booking could not be created.
reservar.err_ocupado: That slot was just taken. Pick another.
reservar.err_mantenimiento: That slot is closed for maintenance.
reservar.err_saldo: Not enough balance to pay this way.
reservar.err_fecha: You can only book up to 7 days ahead.
reservar.payReminder: Bank-transfer payment: the booking is held for 3 days. If the administrator does not confirm the payment within that time, it is released automatically. If you cancel a paid booking, the amount is refunded to your home balance.

profile.title: Profile
profile.balanceHint: Only created by cancellations. Used when booking.

editProfile.title: Edit details
editProfile.homeHint: To change home, contact the administrator.
editProfile.required: First name and last name are required.
editProfile.failed: Could not save. Please try again.

reservaDetalle.title: Booking details
reservaDetalle.transferPendingBody: Make the transfer and the administrator will confirm the booking. If it doesn't arrive within 3 days, the slot is released.
reservaDetalle.accessNote: The room access code will arrive on the day of the booking (access control, Phase 7).
reservaDetalle.confirmCancel: Are you sure? If it was paid, the amount goes back as home balance.
reservaDetalle.err_tarde: Too late to cancel: less than an hour before the start.
reservaDetalle.err_estado: This booking can no longer be cancelled.

sugerencias.title: Suggestion box
sugerencias.subtitle: Write a suggestion and it will reach the administrator.
